value.rationale: The homogeneous one-excitation icosahedron is a physically meaningful constrained transport device. A sharp quadratic exponent plus constructive Pell times and rigorous non-attainment quantifies the waiting-time cost of near-unit fidelity without engineered long-range interactions; this is motivated and not a mere isolated enumeration. The exact global leading constant is deliberately not claimed.
